text:
Avery: O.K. important poll for science: name the sandwich that most obviously matches your vibe. no wrong answers, optional theatrics. 
Samir: Tuna salad on multigrain. Practical, a little tangy, surprisingly fancy in a lunchbox. :sunglasses:
Nia: Fluffernutter (marshmallow + PB). chaotic sweet energy, lives for nostalgia. :sparkles:
Miguel: Monte Cristo. dramatic, may require deep-frying, will show up to events in a cape. :clinking_glasses:
Priya: Open-faced smoked salmon with dill. elegant but approachable, small plates of personality. :fish:
Jenna: Cold-cut stack with too many pickles. chaotic neutral. also an excellent midnight snack.
Samir: honorable mention: the invisible salad wrap 12% lettuce 88% attitude.
Avery: ops-bot can you make a quick react-to-vote? 
ops-bot: Poll made 12options: Tuna salad / Fluffernutter / Monte Cristo / Smoked salmon open-face / Cold-cut stack / Invisible salad wrap. React to vote.
Miguel: Voted Monte Cristo :white_check_mark: also bringing one to the kitchen tomorrow for taste-testing. 
Nia: Fluffernutter all the way. someone please gif me sunlight and childhood cartoons.
Priya: Smoked salmon, and I will pair it with strong black tea. fussy pairing preferences, sorry.
Jenna: Cold-cut stack + root beer float. prove me wrong.
Avery: Results so far: Monte Cristo leads by one dramatic bite. thanks team, approved for wildly impractical snack ideas.
